name: Profiteroles
description: Choux puffs filled with vanilla ice cream and blanketed in a warm dark chocolate sauce at the table.
ingredients: a generous handful of button mushrooms
a handful of fresh tarragon, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with extra-virgin olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the baguette and cracked black peppercorns until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the cognac with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 25 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with parsley or a dusting of crème fraîche.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
